title: New Keynesian Integration after General-Equilibrium Compatibility
research_question: Which equilibrium-compatible statistical-mechanical mechanisms add distinct predictions for inflation, monetary transmission, wealth inequality and welfare once nominal rigidity is introduced?
feasibility_hypothesis: Proceed only after mechanisms in Stages 2–7 have individually passed feasibility, rational-expectations and market-clearing checks.
mechanisms: Calvo staggered prices and optimal reset pricing
Embedding of validated exchange, social, credit and trading mechanisms
Nonlinear inflation, output, inequality and welfare effects
state_variables: goods-price dispersion and monetary policy states
firm credit and security markets, where validated
required_equations: Firm dynamic optimal pricing and Calvo price index
Household Euler/Bellman equations with rational equilibrium forecasts
Goods, labor, money/bonds and security-market clearing
Central bank policy rule and equilibrium transition
comparison_baseline: Standard NK and HANK benchmark without statistical-mechanical components
acceptance_tests: Recover flexible-price and conventional HANK limits
Exact Calvo price aggregation and pricing FOC
Monetary-policy impulse response with full asset and resource accounting
Welfare evaluated on optimized households and stable equilibrium
stage_gate: Do not implement before Stages 0–4 pass their core gates; optional firm/finance modules enter only if Stages 5–7 pass.

implementation.method: equilibrium solving plus ABM/distribution verification when relevant
implementation.language: Julia proposed; environment and APIs to be verified before implementation
